title: specs/project_setup.json (Stage 0 — Project Setup, ALM/SCM Connection & ADO/Jira Project Selection)

ceremonyTrack.description: Adaptive governance ceremony track: 'quick' streamlines intermediate gates for rapid prototypes/hackathons while preserving critical scope, stack/contract, and guardrail eval stops; 'standard' enforces balanced human-in-the-loop gates; 'regulated' enforces every human gate plus Stage 4A adversarial red-team scorecard.

domainPacks.description: Optional specialized MCP domain packs enabled for legacy/enterprise estates (e.g., Migration Center codmod .NET/Java/cloud-SDK assessment, mainframe AST, database migration, warehouse SQL translation, distributed batch migration, or 3P agent codebase auditing).

activeWave.description: Optional active Strangler Capability Group wave ID (e.g. 'GRP-01') for incremental wave execution.

specLifecycleMode.description: SDD lifecycle mode: 'standard' (greenfield or full/wave modernization), 'delta' (Phase N+1 living-spec append preserving completed phases and historic approvals), or 'retro-spec' (reverse-engineer an existing production system into a verified COMPLETED living spec with zero backlog ticket creation).

reviewPlane.description: Human review & approval plane: 'alm-and-git' (Jira/ADO thin-pointer chained stories + Git PR/briefs), 'git-pr-docs-as-code' (Git PRs + CODEOWNERS + inline Phased Approvals ledger when almPlatform=='none'), or 'interactive-briefs' (local Gate Decision Briefs + gate_approvals.json).
